subject: Re: SIG questionnaire — audit log export, retention & customer access
messages:
From: Sofia Reyes <sofia.reyes@atlashealth.com>
To: diego_fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: AtlasHealth Procurement <procurement@atlashealth.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG questionnaire - audit log exports and retention

Diego,

Thanks for taking this. We received the SIG last week and have a couple of focused asks around audit logs while we finish the full review:

- Can Redwood produce customer-scoped event exports (NDJSON) on demand?
- What is the default retention for platform audit logs vs. tenant-level events?
- Does the export include request/response payload hashes, and can we get a sample?

I've attached the SIG worksheet with the relevant rows highlighted (SIG_AtlasHealth_Q1_2027.xlsx). Procurement would like a short mutual action plan and any evidence links we can hand to our security team.

Also: we operate in US commercial regions only — please call out any cross-border export considerations.

Best,
Sofia Reyes
Director, Security Operations
AtlasHealth

Attachment: SIG_AtlasHealth_Q1_2027.xlsx (spreadsheet, 180 KB)

From: diego_fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Reyes <sofia.reyes@atlashealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire - audit log exports and retention

Hi Sofia — thanks for the clear asks. Quick answers up-front, then proposed next steps: 

- On-demand exports: yes. We provide tenant-scoped audit exports in NDJSON. Exports include event metadata, timestamps, actor, resource identifiers, and optional payload hashes.
- Retention: platform operational logs (infra/agent telemetry) are retained 90 days by default; tenant audit events are retained 365 days by default for Hosted customers (configurable on Dedicated/Private).
- Sample: attaching a small sample (audit-logs-sample.ndjson) and a short schema doc.

Next steps I propose:
1) Marissa (Security) will add the SOC 2 assertion and a short evidence list.
2) We can provide a scoped export within 48 hours for your security team to validate format.
3) If you need longer retention, we can propose a retention add-on and an export-runbook for procurement.

Are you available for a 30-min sync tomorrow?

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: audit-logs-sample.ndjson (text, 12 KB)

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Reyes <sofia.reyes@atlashealth.com>, diego_fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 13:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire - audit log exports and retention

Sofia — adding the security perspective and evidence pointers. Per SIG rows: we typically map the questions to artifacts; below are the most relevant items we can provide immediately:

- Export capability: internal runbook + sample export (attached) + script to sanitize PII if required. Link to runbook: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cRedwood/SIG-evidence
- Retention: default values as Diego stated. For Dedicated/Private we offer policy controls (retention windows) and an export pipeline to a customer-owned S3 bucket.
- Schema & hashes: we include SHA-256 hashes for payloads; schema doc at https://docs.redwood.ai/internal/security/audit-log-schema.md. Sample snippet (from audit-logs-sample.ndjson):

{
  "timestamp": "2027-03-22T15:02:03Z",
  "tenant_id": "atlas-001",
  "actor": "service-account:ingest-proxy",
  "event": "generate:response",
  "resource": "model/text-davinci-003",
  "payload_hash": "sha256:abcd1234..."
}

Export options we need to clarify with you:
- Destination: Atlas-owned S3 vs. push to secure share.
- Encryption: server-side-customer-managed keys (SSE-CMK) or Redwood-managed keys.
- Regional residency: we can restrict export jobs to US regions only.

I can pull the SOC 2 section (redwood-soc2-assertion.pdf) and a minimal evidence pack for your team this afternoon.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-soc2-assertion.pdf (pdf, 220 KB)

From: Evan Cho <evan.cho@vendor-s3.com>
To: diego_fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sofia Reyes <sofia.reyes@atlashealth.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire - audit log exports and retention

Looping in our S3 integration lead for technical detail. Short answers from the storage side:

- Cross-region copy: supported, but subject to Atlas's bucket policy and any legal transfer restrictions.
- Object metadata: we preserve custom metadata (e.g., payload-hash) on objects.
- Access controls: we recommend Atlas configure an IAM role with least privilege and provide us the role ARN; Redwood will write objects with that role to your bucket.

If you prefer a managed export job, we can provide a short interface where Atlas provides a destination bucket ARN and key prefix; Redwood will write nightly exports there.

—Evan
Evan Cho
Integration Engineer, Vendor-S3
